applicableRules.title: Security review is never skipped
applicableRules.description: Check changed trust boundaries, authentication, authorization, secret handling, injection risks, and unsafe browser APIs. Scale depth to the change, but do not skip the dimension because user knowledge is absent.

applicableRules.title: Preserve accessibility basics
applicableRules.description: Keep semantic structure, keyboard operation, accessible names, focus behavior, and readable contrast intact for affected user interfaces.

applicableRules.title: Verify with discovered capabilities
applicableRules.description: Run real scripts discovered from the target repository. When the required checks do not exist, establish the minimum compatible test environment and scripts within the authorized scope, rediscover them, then execute. Missing checks are unverified, not passed.

applicableRules.title: Keep state ownership narrow
applicableRules.description: Prefer server state or query cache for remote data, URL state for shareable navigation state, form state inside the form, and component state for local interaction. Use global client state only when independent areas truly share ownership.

applicableRules.title: Separate business rules from UI mechanics
applicableRules.description: Keep reusable business invariants testable without rendering a component. Do not impose domain layers on simple presentation code.

applicableRules.title: Control asynchronous lifecycles
applicableRules.description: Review cancellation, stale responses, cache invalidation, optimistic rollback, loading, empty, and error states whenever asynchronous behavior changes.

applicableRules.title: Add tests before running checks
applicableRules.description: Capture a baseline before changing code/tests. Inspect the affected behavior and existing coverage, add only missing applicable cases within the authorized scope, then run checks. Preserve domain guarantees across interface/test rewrites. Explicit review-only requests produce proposals without edits.

applicableRules.title: Review dependency and bundle cost
applicableRules.description: Prefer platform features and installed dependencies. New client dependencies require a concrete need and bundle-impact review.

applicableRules.title: Preserve operational visibility
applicableRules.description: User-visible failures need an intentional error path. Review logging, error boundaries, monitoring hooks, and cross-browser behavior where relevant.
